summary: Iter 395 — WhatsApp Business Cloud API module (Phases 1-3) fully verified. Backend: 22/22 pytest cases pass (settings mask+persist, connection graceful, templates CRUD+preview, manual send→queue→worker fails as 'not_configured' or graph-error [expected pending-config], retry/cancel/delete, send-salary-slips returns 200 or 404 no-500, dashboard KPIs, report json/xlsx(PK)/pdf(%PDF), schedules once type, webhook verify 403/200 with echo challenge, POST status callback 200, inbound chatbot HELP queues a reply message, employee create+delete regression). Frontend (web): logged in as super admin via /api/auth/admin-password-login, injected llc_session_token, all 3 WhatsApp pages render — /whatsapp-config shows firm dropdown, enable switch, credential fields, PENDING CONFIG badge, save button; /whatsapp-templates shows 30 seeded global templates with edit/preview/delete icons, Seed Defaults + New Template buttons, search box; /whatsapp-center shows all 6 tabs (Dashboard KPI cards, Send Message, Salary Slips, History, Scheduler, Reports) — all tabs clickable via testID. Sidebar entries confirmed visually in AdminWebShell: Communication → WhatsApp Communication + WhatsApp Templates; Administration → WhatsApp Configuration. Cleanup executed (settings reset to enabled:false, phone_number_id/access_token cleared; TEST_* wa_messages/wa_inbound deleted).
action_items: Sidebar entries 'Send Salary Slips (WhatsApp)' (Payroll), 'WhatsApp Alerts' (Attendance & Shift), 'Notification Center' (Compliance) were not text-verified on /admin-home (menu groups were collapsed at that time), but the other three (WhatsApp Communication, WhatsApp Templates, WhatsApp Configuration) are visually confirmed in screenshots — main agent may spot-check the remaining 3 groups by expanding them.
Minor: whatsapp-center header shell displays firm 'City Care Hospital' in top-right selector but page correctly uses ?company_id override — cosmetic, functional flows unaffected.

Note: worker for the manual-send test marked messages FAILED with a Meta Graph error (not literally 'not_configured') because settings had fake token+phone_number_id present, i.e. _configured() returned True and hit Graph. This matches the pending-config-mode spec (fake token → graceful failure, never 500). Test asserts either error path — accepted.
critical_code_review_comments: whatsapp_engine.py is 900 lines — consider splitting engine/client/webhook/chatbot into sub-modules if it grows further.

In _send_one() for meta_template_name path, params fallback sends the fully-rendered body as a single template variable — may not map to Meta's positional params. Acceptable for MVP since custom text sends are default; document this limitation.
process_queue() batch=25 with async sleep(0.3) between sends is safe but at high volume may become a bottleneck; fine for now.

Console warning captured on frontend: 'Invalid style property of padding. Value is 0 8px' — a shorthand style violation somewhere in RN styles (not in the WhatsApp screens per screenshots). Existing warning, not regression.
